about: Hand corrections for when the official injury label is misleading. Match on name + team. Any field listed replaces the automatic one (injury, note, typical, reinjury, evidence, source, source_url, pickup). "hold": true hides the note and pickup and shows only the official status and practice trail. "until" is the last day it applies; after that the job ignores it and lists it in data/checks.json.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.why: Official label says calf; it's a blood clot in the calf, not a strain
players.note: Not a calf strain: it's a blood clot in his calf. If the clot stays superficial, he could be back around Week 8 or 9. The likelier path is about six weeks of blood thinners, which points to Week 11 or 12. If it becomes a deep-vein clot, he's out into January.
players.source: FFD: Jalen Hurts blood clot return timeline
